overview_description.description: Cumulus Networks has developed the first true, full-featured Linux operating system for networking hardware. Just as Linux transformed the economics and accelerated the pace of innovation on the server-side of the data center, Cumulus Linux is doing the same for the network side. We are radically reducing the cost and complexity of operating modern data center networks and enabling the true promise of the software-defined data center.

about_short_description.short_description: Cumulus Networks is a software company that designs and sells Linux operating systems for networking hardware.

product.name: NVIDIA Cumulus Linux
product.description: An open network operating system designed for scalability and advanced networking features, built to run on a variety of hardware platforms.

product.name: NVIDIA Spectrum Switches
product.description: A series of Ethernet switches optimized for AI, cloud, and storage workloads, offering high-speed connectivity and flexibility.

product.name: NVIDIA Air
product.description: A platform for simulating data center deployments, creating digital twins to streamline network operations through validation and automation.

product.name: NVIDIA NetQ
product.description: A network operations tool providing real-time visibility, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management for data center networks.

product.name: NVIDIA Pure SONiC
product.description: An open-source network operating system based on Linux, designed for use on switches from multiple vendors, supporting large-scale data centers.

product.name: NVIDIA Linux Switch
product.description: A solution allowing the use of any standard Linux distribution as the switch operating system on NVIDIA Spectrum switches.
